chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahboub, from Shu'ayb al-Aqarqufi, who said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying to his companions: 'Fear Allah and become righteous brothers, loving one another for the sake of Allah, maintaining ties, showing mercy, visiting each other, meeting, and remembering our matter (Wilayah), and reviving it.'

key_terms.مُتَحَابِّينَ فِي اللَّهِ: loving one another for the sake of Allah

ai.seo_question: What are the key characteristics of brotherhood and social connection emphasized by Imam al-Sadiq in this hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) instructs his companions to embody 'Ikhwa Barara' (righteous brothers) by maintaining continuous social ties (Tazawwur) and mutual compassion, which are essential for preserving the identity of the Shia community. This hadith underscores the practical application of Wilayah through active engagement, where visiting and remembering the Ahl al-Bayt serves to revitalize the spiritual and social fabric of the Ummah.
